description: This PHP class defines a plugin component for the Revive Adserver, specifically handling log click data for openX delivery logs. It provides methods to retrieve database table names, table columns, and migration mappings related to click logging.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLog_OxLogClick_LogClick
classes.description: A plugin class for handling click log data in openX delivery logs within the Revive Adserver.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies for the log click plugin component.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the bucket table used for storing click data.

methods.name: getBucketTableColumns
methods.description: Returns the columns and their types for the bucket table.

methods.name: getStatisticsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the statistics table for aggregated data.

methods.name: getStatisticsMigration
methods.description: Provides the mapping for migrating bucket data into statistics.
